comparison.objective: Read a diagnostic blink code, replace the indicated module, and verify a green status; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Temporal signal interpretation, keyed module extraction/insertion, and button holding versus fine two-tool countertorque on threaded hardware.
comparison.success_condition: Failed module removed, teal spare seated in socket 3, healthy modules retained, DIAG held for green verification, and released state stable one second.
comparison.reason: Diagnostic selection and keyed field-replaceable-unit swapping test a different ability; generic post-work verification does not create overlap.
